name: B10.5 Bug 2 (manual): checkout dispatches ONLY the cleaner at the booking's WS_Property — property B's cleaner is not notified
comment: Two properties, each with one Active cleaner, plus an Active-but-unassigned cleaner. All three are Active, so the {Active} filter cannot be what excludes anyone — only property scoping can. Scope comes from the booking's own WS_Property (recP1), not from a Room->Property walk: recR1 is deliberately left WITHOUT a Property link, so a room-walk-based implementation would resolve nothing and this fixture would fail. Correct behaviour is exactly two sends: Thandi (property A) then the guest. Under the old unscoped `{Active} = TRUE()` dispatch, Bongani (property B) and Sipho (unassigned) are messaged too and the send count goes 2 -> 4, failing the harness's exact-count assertion. That count check is what proves EXCLUSION, not just inclusion.
